description: This file is the entry point for a React application, responsible for rendering the root component (<App />) into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the rendering context with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a new root DOM node for rendering React components.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node.
